##### Project general facts

District One West Phase One is a prestigious residential community by Nakheel, offering an exclusive collection of 4- to 7-bedroom villas designed for refined modern living. Set on spacious plots, the villas combine elegant contemporary architecture with high-quality construction, sophisticated details, and exquisite finishes. Thoughtfully designed homes create a private and luxurious environment for families seeking comfort and style.

The community offers a tranquil lifestyle surrounded by crystal-clear lagoons and canals, scenic greenery, and beautifully planned outdoor spaces. Residents can enjoy access to sports facilities, restaurants, shopping, and a variety of other amenities, creating a well-balanced environment where relaxation, recreation, and everyday convenience come together.

The villas are designed to provide spacious and comfortable living with a strong focus on elegance and functionality. High-quality finishes and carefully considered architectural details enhance the interiors, while the generous plots provide ample private outdoor space. District One West Phase One combines luxury, privacy, and convenience in an exclusive residential setting.

##### Location description and benefits 

Al Quoz 2 is a centrally located residential district in Dubai, situated between Al Khail Road and Meydan Road. The area forms part of the wider Hadaeq Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid district, a prestigious master-planned community known for its upscale residential developments, landscaped surroundings, and growing collection of lifestyle destinations. The location offers convenient access to major roads, making it easy to reach different parts of Dubai.

The neighbourhood combines a peaceful residential atmosphere with convenient urban infrastructure. Al Quoz 2 features villas, residential properties, local amenities, and green spaces, while nearby Al Quoz Pond Park provides a family-friendly outdoor destination with a pond, jogging tracks, and picnic areas. The surrounding Hadaeq Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid community further enhances the area with landscaped parks, water features, and pedestrian-friendly spaces.

Thanks to its central position and strong road connectivity, residents have convenient access to key destinations across Dubai. Al Quoz 2 is close to Dubai Hills, Meydan, Downtown Dubai, and other established communities, while Al Khail Road provides direct connections to major business, retail, and leisure hubs. The combination of accessibility, greenery, and a growing residential environment makes the area an attractive choice for modern family living.
